verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect documents platform pricing tools that let a platform implement a range of pricing strategies without code, and it supports splitting charges between the platform and sellers, which covers setting the sell rate. Nothing in the pack documents a platform buy rate or interchange-level cost visibility for managing the spread; the community comments only mention list fees and confusion over fees. Missing for 10: a documented platform buy rate, interchange-level or interchange-plus cost reporting, and spread or margin visibility tools.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I control the economics — a documented buy rate from the provider and freedom to set the sell rate my sellers see, with interchange-level cost visibility to manage the spread

citations.quote: platforms can implement a range of pricing strategies for different payment processing use-cases, without the need to write any code
Create a charge and split payments between your platform and your sellers or service providers.
